footer.description: OnubHiking guides you through the best hiking trails in Huelva and Andalusia. Discover paths, GPS tracks, and passionate hiker communities.

lista.title: Piedras River Marshes Natural Area
lista.audience: Ideal for bird watching in a unique marsh landscape. Recommended for families with older children and leashed pets.
lista.description: Circular route with marsh landscapes and bird watching throughout the journey.

lista.title: Doñana National Park
lista.audience: Perfect for all levels, including children and seniors. Pets allowed.
lista.description: Accessible trail between dunes and marshes with great wealth of fauna and flora.

lista.title: Lime Kilns (Hornos de Cal)
lista.audience: Suitable for active families with children accustomed to walking. Pets welcome.
lista.description: A tour that combines natural history with industrial heritage in a mountain environment.

lista.title: Mining Train Way and Riotinto Mines
lista.audience: Recommended for adults and teenagers; not suitable for small children or pets.
lista.description: Itinerary through the 'Martian' landscape of the Riotinto mines and the old railway track.

lista.title: Castaño del Robledo and Picos de Aroche
lista.audience: Only for experienced hikers with good physical condition.
lista.description: Demanding route with steep slopes and spectacular mountain views.

lista.title: Jabugo Riverside
lista.audience: Ideal for families with children of all ages. Flat and shaded terrain.
lista.description: Walk along the Múrtiga River, one of the freshest and most accessible routes in the area.

lista.title: Charco Malo Trail
lista.audience: Suitable for families with children accustomed to walking. Leashed pets.
lista.description: Route towards spectacular waterfalls in a very photogenic setting.

lista.title: Alájar Trail
lista.audience: Perfect for starting in hiking. Ideal for children, seniors, and pets.
lista.description: Short and accessible path around Alájar, ideal as a first experience.

lista.title: Enchanted Forest Route
lista.audience: Suitable for families with children over 8 years old and pets with hiking experience.
lista.description: Journey through cork oaks, holm oaks, and ancient chestnut trees in a very shady environment.

lista.title: El Talenque-Valdelarco Trail
lista.audience: Perfect for the whole family, including small children and pets.
lista.description: Well-marked historical trail with accessible terrain and mountain views.

hero.subtitle: Equip yourself like a pro to enjoy Huelva

items.title: Footwear
items.description: Hiking boots with good grip and waterproofing.

items.title: Canteen
items.description: At least 1.5 liters. Staying hydrated is key.

items.title: First Aid Kit
items.description: Basic kit with disinfectant, bandages, and plasters.

items.title: Sun Protection
items.description: Cap and glasses. UV radiation is intense in the mountains.
